test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Six friends M, N, O, P, Q and R have their tests on a different day of week starting from Monday and ending on Saturday of the same week. Only two friends are having their tests before M's test. Only four friends are having their tests after Q's test. Only O has the test between the tests of P and N. Who amongst the following has the test on Monday?
solution:
**Given: **

Six friends M, N, O, P, Q and R have their tests on a different day of week starting from Monday and ending on Saturday of the same week.

**Solution:**

(1) Only two friends are having their tests before M's test.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48f0850f5ca1f590b51b32e948e35d35457f6a986d3f029d5cc009afbef0e09d.png] 

(2) Only four friends are having their tests after Q's test.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87cd98cf8a25e0cbfd872965e866b0e3858ad6d80310db7d3641a06ea4a53166.png] 

(3) Combining above two steps

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb41610ab556506a6de57957013ae29ea34081b4461f5c96fe8dd10b91781e05.png] 

(4) Only O has the test between the tests of P and N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c193ed820708c63eb7f21bcbc1f0137a526f18b59236ca5be5e34c3297036468.png] 

(5) Now, R can give his test on monday.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80941a54171138e87755b749a5bede2ea340be457063bd5b9a723247f9b51adc.png] 

**Hence, 'option 3' is correct.**
